evidence.description: The actor obtains EcosiaBrowserWindowAuthManager through .shared and invokes its operational dispatchAuthState method.
The profile-change task directly obtains NotificationCenter.default to post a notification.

candidates.explanation: The authentication component directly accesses shared operational services instead of receiving them through explicit, replaceable dependency boundaries.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: getSessionTransferToken checks isLoggedIn before awaiting credential retrieval, then stores the returned SSO credentials without revalidating the login state.
Logout can clear the authentication state through setupTokensWithCredentials(nil) while SSO retrieval is suspended.
setupTokensWithCredentials defaults its login-state argument to false and assigns it to the actor's mutable isLoggedIn property.
SSO credential retrieval awaits the provider, allowing the actor to process other work before returning.

candidates.explanation: getSessionTransferToken relies on its pre-suspension logged-in check when committing SSO credentials after an await. Logout can set isLoggedIn to false during that suspension, but the method does not revalidate the authentication state before storing the result.
candidates.title: Unsafe Actor State Assumption After Suspension
